summary: The V1 failure was test_all_roles_prints_name_and_digest_per_role in bridges/orch-skiller: the resolver now returns the researcher role, but the test's ROLES tuple lacked it. ROLES in bridges/orch-skiller/tests/test_resolve_role.py already includes 'researcher' in the working tree, and I made no new edit this round. bridges/orch-skiller `bash scripts/test.sh` passes (24 tests OK) with a temporary HOME/SKM_HOME and the partner roots wired as scripts/test-bridges.sh does. I did not run V1 itself or the other bridge and package suites.
